rules: Layer 8 (assets/provinces.json) is the only source of territorial geometry for Region.
The hierarchy is authored bottom-up only. This version intentionally contains Region only; C/V/B are disabled until they are rebuilt from verified Regions.
Region may contain only explicit stable province_ids from layer 8; no centroid, bbox, nearest-neighbour, coordinate or shape guessing is allowed.
No Region may carry its own polygon/rings/bbox/coordinates geometry.
A layer-8 province may belong to one Region only.
A historical Region may not mix provinces from different countries.
Historical/geographical correctness has priority over the target size of 3-4 provinces. One-province and 5+ province Regions are allowed when the source requires them.

If exact historical borders cannot be reproduced with whole layer-8 provinces, an explicitly documented historical-geographical gameplay grouping may be used without changing layer-8 geometry; it must not be presented as an exact historical border.
Every authored Region must record internet sources and a historical_basis. Game convenience is never a valid basis.
Unverified world areas remain absent from X instead of being guessed.
Higher tiers must later be derived only from this Region layer and independently verified before C/V/B are enabled.
Portugal is intentionally grouped at Region level into five mainland historical-geographical gameplay Regions plus one Azores+Madeira island Region, using only whole layer-8 provinces as requested.

coverage.note: Spain uses source-backed historical Regions. Portugal uses five mainland historical-geographical gameplay Regions built only from whole layer-8 districts, plus one combined Azores+Madeira Region. Other world layer-8 provinces remain unassigned until researched.

groups.historical_basis: España regional (IGN, 1910) treats Galicia as a historical region. At the layer-8 provincial scale it is exactly La Coruña, Lugo, Orense and Pontevedra; no Portuguese territory is included.
Asturias is a separate Region in España regional (IGN, 1910). Layer 8 currently has one Asturias province, so Province = Region is exact at the available granularity.
The IGN 1912 geographic review explicitly states that the old Kingdom/Region of León comprises León, Zamora and Salamanca.

Castilla la Vieja is one of the explicit historical Regions in the IGN 1910 regional atlas. The current layer-8 La Rioja and Cantabria polygons stand for the historical Logroño and Santander provincial territories at this scale. The eight-province size is retained because historical correctness overrides the 3-4 target average.
The IGN 1912 review explicitly defines Castilla la Nueva as Ciudad Real, Cuenca, Guadalajara, Madrid and Toledo.
The IGN 1912 review explicitly defines Extremadura as Cáceres and Badajoz.
España regional (IGN, 1910) has Vascongadas as a separate northern Region. The 1810 IGN atlas identifies the Provincias Bascongadas as Vizcaya, Guipúzcoa and Álava. Navarra remains a separate Region.
Navarra is a separate Region in the IGN 1910 regional atlas and a separate kingdom in the 1810 atlas. Layer 8 contains it as one province, so Province = Region.
Aragón is a separate historical Region in the IGN 1910 atlas; the layer-8 provinces Zaragoza, Huesca and Teruel reproduce the standard provincial composition.
Cataluña is a separate historical Region in the IGN 1910 atlas. Layer 8 uses Barcelona, Tarragona, Lérida/Lleida and Gerona/Girona.
The IGN 1912 review explicitly defines Valencia as Castellón, Valencia and Alicante.
The IGN 1912 review explicitly defines the historical Murcia Region as Murcia and Albacete.

España regional (IGN, 1910) treats Andalucía as one Region. The IGN 1912 review records its four historical kingdoms and their provinces: Sevilla = Cádiz, Huelva, Sevilla; Córdoba = Córdoba; Jaén = Jaén; Granada = Almería, Granada, Málaga. Their union therefore gives exactly the eight layer-8 Andalusian provinces, without the previous arbitrary western/eastern split.
Baleares is a separate Region in the IGN 1910 regional atlas. Layer 8 currently represents the archipelago as one province, so Province = Region.
Canarias is a separate Region in the IGN regional classification. Layer 8 uses the later two-province subdivision, which is reunited only at Region level.

Игровой Region из целых провинций слоя 8: северо-западный атлантический пояс объединяет Viana do Castelo, Braga, Porto и Aveiro. Группировка опирается на историко-географическую близость Minho/Douro Litoral, но не заявляет точное совпадение с историческими провинциальными границами.

Игровой Region из целых провинций слоя 8: внутренний север и северо-восток объединяют Vila Real, Bragança, Viseu и Guarda. Основа — связный внутренний пояс Trás-os-Montes/верхнего Douro и северных Beiras; точная историческая граница не имитируется.

Игровой Region из целых провинций слоя 8: Coimbra, Castelo Branco и Leiria образуют центральный пояс между атлантическим побережьем и внутренней Beira. Это историко-географическое игровое объединение, а не реконструкция точных границ Beira Litoral/Beira Baixa.
Игровой Region из целых провинций слоя 8: Lisboa, Santarém и Setúbal объединены вокруг нижнего Тежу и лиссабонского ядра, приблизительно связывая Estremadura/Ribatejo в масштабе текущего слоя 8.
Игровой южный Region из целых провинций слоя 8: Portalegre, Évora и Beja составляют ядро Alentejo, Faro добавлен как Algarve для получения одного связного южного Region на текущем игровом масштабе.

По принятому игровому правилу два португальских атлантических архипелага — Azores и Madeira — объединяются в один Region. Геометрия не создаётся: Region состоит только из двух существующих province_id слоя 8.
